facts.fact: Droupadi Murmu is the President of India (since 25 Jul 2022).
C. P. Radhakrishnan is the 15th Vice-President and ex-officio Rajya Sabha Chairman (since 12 Sep 2025).
The early VP election (9 Sep 2025) followed Jagdeep Dhankhar's resignation on health grounds.
Surya Kant was sworn in as the 53rd Chief Justice of India on 24 Nov 2025.
Surya Kant succeeded B. R. Gavai (52nd CJI).
Om Birla is the Lok Sabha Speaker.
Gyanesh Kumar is the Chief Election Commissioner (since 19 Feb 2025).
Sanjay Malhotra is the 26th RBI Governor (since 11 Dec 2024).
General N. S. Raja Subramani became the 3rd CDS on 31 May 2026, succeeding Anil Chauhan.
General Dhiraj Seth became Chief of the Army Staff on 30 Jun 2026.
Admiral Krishna Swaminathan became Chief of the Naval Staff on 31 May 2026.
Air Chief Marshal Amar Preet Singh heads the Indian Air Force.
Vikram Misri is the Foreign Secretary.
Tuhin Kanta Pandey is the SEBI Chairman (since 1 Mar 2025).
Economic Survey 2025-26 estimated FY26 real GDP growth at 7.4%.
The Survey projected FY27 growth at 6.8-7.2%.
Survey theme: from 'Strategic Resilience' to 'Strategic Indispensability'.
The Economic Survey became a separate document in 1964.
Nirmala Sitharaman presented Union Budget 2026-27 on 1 February 2026.
The Income Tax Act, 2025 replaced the Income-tax Act, 1961 from 1 April 2026.
Retail (CPI) inflation was 3.93% in May 2026.
VB-G RAM G replaces MGNREGA and guarantees 125 days of wage work.
The Central Excise (Amendment) Bill, 2025 raised duties on tobacco products.
The National Dental Commission (Mar 2026) replaced the Dental Council of India.
Padma Awards 2026: 131 awards (5 Vibhushan, 13 Bhushan, 113 Shri).
Uday Kotak got the Padma Bhushan, not the Vibhushan, in 2026.
Padma Vibhushan 2026 included V. S. Achuthanandan and Dharmendra (both posthumous).
Violinist N. Rajam received the Padma Vibhushan 2026.
Order of civilian honours: Bharat Ratna > Padma Vibhushan > Padma Bhushan > Padma Shri.
The 'Bharat Ratna Dr. Bhupen Hazarika National Awards' are cultural awards, not the Bharat Ratna.
India ranked 23rd in the Climate Change Performance Index 2026.
The CCPI keeps its top three ranks vacant.
India ranked 80th in the Henley Passport Index 2026.
India was 3rd and a 'major power' in the Lowy Asia Power Index 2025.
India ranked 3rd in the Global AI Vibrancy Index (Stanford HAI).
India is the largest milk producer (~247.87 million tonnes).
India ranks 4th in creative-services exports (UNCTAD).
India ranked 4th in the Global Firepower Index 2025 (USA 1st).
India ranked 157th of 180 in the World Press Freedom Index 2026 (5 May 2026).
India ranked 38th in the Global Innovation Index 2025; Switzerland topped it.
INS Mahe is the lead ship of the Mahe-class ASW shallow-water craft.
INS Aridaman is India's third indigenous SSBN.
DRDO's LRLACM was flight-tested from Abdul Kalam Island, Odisha.
NISAR is a joint NASA-ISRO earth-observation radar satellite.
The first PSLV built by Indian industry (HAL-L&T) marks private entry into launch vehicles.
The PSLV-C62 mission failed (12 Jan 2026).
India hosted the AI Impact Summit in New Delhi (16-20 Feb 2026).
India and the European Union concluded a free trade agreement (2026).
The New Zealand-India FTA was signed in New Delhi (28 Apr 2026).
The 2026 Men's T20 World Cup was co-hosted by India and Sri Lanka.
India beat New Zealand in the T20 World Cup final at Ahmedabad on 8 March 2026 (3rd title).
Noida International Airport at Jewar (UP) was inaugurated on 28 Mar 2026.
Assembly polls in Apr-May 2026: Assam, Kerala, Tamil Nadu, West Bengal and Puducherry.
Bhubaneswar will host the 2028 World Athletics Indoor Championships.
The International Big Cat Alliance covers seven big cat species.
Hockey player Hardik Singh was the Khel Ratna 2025 nominee.
Yogasana athlete Aarti Pal was the first recommended for the Arjuna Award.
Rashtriya Vigyan Puraskar categories: Vigyan Ratna, Vigyan Shri, Vigyan Yuva, Vigyan Team.
The SC recommended a 'Romeo-Juliet clause' in the POCSO Act (Jan 2026).
The 2025 Jnanpith Award went to Tamil poet R. Vairamuthu.
Jnanpith was instituted in 1961; first recipient G. Sankara Kurup (1965).
Sahitya Akademi Awards 2025 covered 24 languages.
In the Tiger Global case (19 Feb 2026) the Supreme Court ruled for the Revenue Department.
ISRO conducted Gaganyaan IADT-02 at Sriharikota on 10 Apr 2026.
India's first indigenous CRISPR gene therapy targets Sickle Cell Disease (May 2026).
Chandrayaan-3 won the AIAA Goddard Astronautics Award (May 2026).
ECLGS 5.0 was approved on 5 May 2026.
The Small Hydro Power Development Scheme covers 2026-2031.
The Mobile Phone Manufacturing Scheme (MPMS) aims at domestic value addition (Jul 2026).
PM Surya Sarovar Yojana (31 Jul 2026) is for floating solar with storage.
EPFO's VISHWAS scheme (17 Jul 2026) eases employer settlements.
'Seafarer-First' (15 Jul 2026) protects Indian seafarers' welfare.
Exercise Maitri-XV (Aug 2026) is with Thailand.
Exercise Pitch Black 2026 was hosted by Australia.
Khaan Quest is held in Mongolia.
Anahat Singh became the first Indian girls' singles world junior squash champion (26 Jul 2026).
Sarvesh Kushare won high-jump silver at CWG 2026, Glasgow.
On 7 Oct 2026 the MPC raised the repo rate by 25 bps to 5.50%.
It was the first repo hike since February 2023.
After the hike SDF is 5.25% and MSF/Bank Rate 5.75%.
Low retail inflation had let the RBI hold rates through most of 2026.
The four labour codes came into force on 21 November 2025.
The Piprahwa relics were found in 1898 by W. C. Peppe at a site identified with Kapilavastu.
The Piprahwa inscription is in Brahmi, not Kharosthi.
58 countries had eliminated at least one NTD by early 2026 (WHO).
The revised MSME classification took effect on 1 April 2025.
India-UK CETA = Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement.
India took the BRICS chairship on 1 January 2026.
'GST 2.0' (3 Sep 2025) cut and rationalised GST rates.
PM Modi's Sep 2025 Manipur visit was his first since the May 2023 violence.
The SC stayed parts of the Waqf (Amendment) Act, 2025 (Sep 2025).
The IAF retired the MiG-21 on 26 Sep 2025 after about 62 years.
Himachal's Cold Desert became a UNESCO biosphere reserve (Sep 2025).
The 18th BRICS Summit (Bharat Mandapam, 12-13 Sep 2026) adopted the New Delhi Declaration.
Suvendu Adhikari became Chief Minister of West Bengal on 9 May 2026 after a BJP landslide.
Vijay (TVK) took oath as Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu on 10 May 2026.
V. D. Satheesan (UDF) became Chief Minister of Kerala in May 2026.
Himanta Biswa Sarma began a second consecutive term as Assam CM on 12 May 2026.
In Puducherry the AINRC was the single largest party and the NDA retained power.
Samrat Choudhary succeeded Nitish Kumar as Bihar CM on 14 Apr 2026.
D. K. Shivakumar replaced Siddaramaiah as Karnataka CM (28 May 2026).
Yumnam Khemchand Singh became Manipur CM on 4 Feb 2026, ending President's rule.
Nitin Nabin was elected BJP National President (Jan 2026).
Harivansh is the Deputy Chairman of the Rajya Sabha.
After Dharmendra Pradhan resigned (25 Jul 2026), Pralhad Joshi got the Education Ministry.
V. Narayanan is the ISRO Chairman.
Cabinet Secretary T. V. Somanathan got a one-year extension (Aug 2026).
The Constitution (131st Amendment) Bill, 2026 (Lok Sabha 543 to 850 seats) was defeated on 17 Apr 2026 for want of a two-thirds majority.
On 11 Mar 2026 the SC allowed passive euthanasia for Harish Rana, the first such court approval.
The SC upheld the Election Commission's Special Intensive Revision on 27 May 2026 (Art 324).
NTA cancelled NEET-UG 2026 (held 3 May) over a paper leak; re-exam on 21 Jun.
Parliament passed the Public Examinations (Prevention of Unfair Means) Amendment Bill, 2026 on 30 Jul 2026.
The VB-G RAM G Act came into force on 1 July 2026, replacing MGNREGA.
On 30 Mar 2026 the Centre said the Naxalite insurgency had been ended.
Phase 1 of Census 2027, the Houselisting and Housing Census, ran from April 2026.
Union Budget 2026-27 targets a fiscal deficit of 4.3% of GDP.
Budget 2026-27 capital expenditure is ₹12.2 lakh crore (4.4% of GDP).
The 16th Finance Commission (Arvind Panagariya) kept states' share at 41% for 2026-31.
Provisional estimates (5 Jun 2026) put FY26 real GDP growth at 7.7%.
Real GDP grew 7.8% in Q1 (Apr-Jun) of FY27.
The Oct 2026 MPC projected FY27 GDP growth at 7.1%.
The 77th Republic Day (theme '150 Years of Vande Mataram') had EU leaders Ursula von der Leyen and António Costa as chief guests.
The India-EU FTA was concluded at the 16th EU-India Summit on 27 Jan 2026.
Sarnath became India's 45th UNESCO World Heritage Site (25 Jul 2026, 48th session, Busan).
India's Ramsar sites reached 103 with Sauj Jheel (UP) and Sukhna Lake (Chandigarh) on 15 Oct 2026.
Tamil Nadu has the most Ramsar sites (20).
Anant Nag received the Dadasaheb Phalke Award (2024) at the 72nd National Film Awards on 22 Sep 2026.
The 72nd National Film Awards were held at Ekta Nagar, Gujarat — first outside Delhi.
At the 72nd NFA Yami Gautam was Best Actress; Mammootty and Kartik Aaryan shared Best Actor.
NSA Ajit Doval received the Lokmanya Tilak National Award 2026 (1 Aug, Pune).
Varsha Aglawe became the first woman Director General of the GSI (Jul 2026).
At the Asian Games 2026 (Aichi-Nagoya) India finished 4th with 85 medals (21 gold).
India's men's hockey team won gold at the Asian Games 2026.
At CWG 2026, Glasgow, India won 39 medals (13 gold).
Mirabai Chanu won India's first gold at CWG 2026 (her third straight CWG title).
GSLV-F17 put EOS-05 (GISAT-1A) in orbit on 4 Sep 2026 — ISRO's first successful launch of 2026.
